legal.cancellationRefundIntro: Effective version: 2026-07. These admin-set platform rules apply to all paid Uniday bookings and cannot be changed by individual merchants.
legal.refundCustomerEarly: More than 24 hours before appointment: 95% refund.
legal.refundCustomerLate: Less than 6 hours before appointment: no refund.
legal.refundMerchantCaused: Merchant-caused cancellations, unavailable services, or rejected merchant reschedules receive 100% refund.
legal.rescheduleUntil: Rescheduling is allowed until 6 hours before the appointment.
legal.rescheduleAvailability: Rescheduling is subject to merchant availability.
legal.rescheduleNoCharge: There is no additional charge for rescheduling.
legal.reschedulePaymentTransfer: Existing payment is transferred to the new booking.
legal.processingFeesSummary: Payment processing fees may not be returned by the payment gateway when a refund is issued.
legal.merchantCausedBody: If a merchant cancels a confirmed booking, cannot provide the booked service, or changes the appointment and the customer rejects the new time, the customer is entitled to a 100% refund.
legal.processingFeesBody: Payment processing fees charged by payment gateways may not be returned to Uniday or the merchant when a refund is issued. The 95% early-cancellation refund is designed to reduce merchant out-of-pocket fee exposure while still giving customers a fair refund.
legal.termsIntro: Effective version: 2026-07. By using Uniday, customers and merchants agree to the booking, payment, cancellation, refund, payout, and account rules shown on the platform.
legal.termsCustomerBody: Customer terms: Customers must provide accurate booking and contact details, complete payment before the payment hold expires, attend appointments on time, and follow the cancellation/rescheduling rules shown before checkout.
legal.termsMerchantBody: Merchant terms: Merchants must keep services, prices, availability, staff, and business details accurate. Merchants are responsible for fulfilling confirmed bookings or resolving merchant-caused cancellations according to Uniday policy.
legal.termsPayoutBody: Merchant payout terms: Uniday keeps a 10% platform commission from paid bookings. The merchant share is 90% of the paid booking amount minus Stripe processing fees and any dispute fees. Payouts are generated every Monday. Eligible completed paid bookings with appointment dates before the current Monday are grouped into one weekly payout batch per merchant.
legal.termsPolicyPrefix: All paid bookings are subject to the
legal.termsSuspensionBody: Uniday may suspend accounts for fraud, abuse, repeated no-shows, payment abuse, or misuse of platform features.
legal.privacyIntro: Uniday collects only the account, booking, payment status, notification, payout, and support information needed to operate the platform.
legal.privacyCustomerBody: For customers, Uniday uses profile and contact details to create bookings, send confirmations, reminders, waitlist alerts, refund updates, receipts, loyalty rewards, and support replies.
legal.privacyMerchantBody: For merchants, Uniday uses business, staff, service, availability, verification, promotion, payout, and contact details to operate storefronts, bookings, admin approvals, settlement records, and merchant support.
legal.privacyPaymentBody: Payment card details are handled by the payment gateway. Uniday stores payment status, references, receipt links, refund records, and fee records where applicable, but does not store raw card numbers.
legal.privacyRetentionBody: Account, booking, payment, refund, payout, review, and support records may be retained for operational, security, audit, and dispute-resolution purposes.
legal.privacyContactBody: Customer contact details are used for booking confirmation, reminders, waitlist notifications, refunds and support. Merchant business information is shown where it is needed for discovery, booking and customer communication.

merchantTerms.intro: Effective version: 2026-07. Merchant accounts must accept these terms during registration before the account can be submitted for verification.
merchantTerms.acceptIntro: Uniday has updated the platform cancellation, refund, payout, and fee rules. Please accept them before continuing to the merchant dashboard.
merchantTerms.signupAgreementPolicy: and platform refund/payout rules: customer cancellations more than 24 hours before appointment receive 95%, 6-24 hours receive 50%, less than 6 hours/no-show receive 0%, merchant-caused cancellations receive 100%, and merchant payout is generated every Monday as 90% minus processor/dispute fees after Uniday's 10% commission.
merchantTerms.bodyAppointments: Merchants agree to honour confirmed appointments, maintain accurate service availability, and keep business contact details up to date.
merchantTerms.bodyRefundRules: Merchants accept Uniday admin-set platform cancellation, refund, and rescheduling rules. Customer-caused cancellations receive 95%, 50%, or 0% refund depending on timing. Rescheduling is allowed until 6 hours before the appointment, subject to merchant availability, with no additional charge and the existing payment transferred to the new booking.
merchantTerms.bodyProcessingFees: Merchants absorb Stripe/payment gateway processing fees and any dispute fees connected to their bookings. These fees are deducted from the merchant payout where applicable.
merchantTerms.bodyPayoutRules: Uniday keeps a 10% platform commission. Merchant payout is calculated as 90% of the paid booking amount minus processor and dispute fees. Payouts are generated every Monday. Eligible completed paid bookings with appointment dates before the current Monday are grouped into one weekly payout batch per merchant, and each booking can only be added to one payout batch after meeting all payout requirements.
merchantTerms.bodyStricterSettings: Cancellation, refund, rescheduling, payout, and fee rules are set by Uniday admin and apply to all merchants. Merchants cannot edit or override these platform terms.

merchantPolicy.subtitle: View Uniday's admin-set cancellation and rescheduling terms.
merchantPolicy.baseline: Uniday policy: more than 24 hours = 95% refund, 6-24 hours = 50%, less than 6 hours/no-show = 0%. Rescheduling is allowed until 6 hours before the appointment.

reply.acknowledgement: Hi, thanks for contacting Uniday Support. We have received your request and are checking it now. We will update you as soon as possible.
reply.booking_issue: Hi, thanks for letting us know. We are checking your booking details and will help you resolve the issue as soon as possible. Please include your booking ID if you have not shared it yet.
reply.payment_issue: Hi, thanks for reaching out. We are reviewing your payment issue. Please do not share card details, passwords, or one-time codes. We will update you once we have checked the payment status.
reply.refund_issue: Hi, thanks for contacting Uniday Support. We are checking the refund details for your request. Please include the booking ID if you have not shared it yet, and we will update you after reviewing the record.
reply.voucher_promotion_issue: Hi, thanks for letting us know. We are reviewing the voucher or promotion issue and checking the eligibility details. We will update you once we have confirmed what happened.
reply.whatsapp_issue: Hi, thanks for contacting us. We are checking the WhatsApp notification issue and will follow up once we have reviewed the message status.
reply.account_issue: Hi, thanks for contacting Uniday Support. We are checking your account issue now. Please do not share passwords, OTPs, or private security details.
reply.merchant_issue: Hi, thanks for letting us know. We are reviewing the merchant-related issue and will follow up once we have checked the details.
reply.technical_issue: Hi, thanks for reporting this. We are reviewing the technical issue and checking the affected steps. Please share what you were trying to do if you have not already included it.
reply.more_information: Hi, thanks for contacting Uniday Support. Could you please share more details about what happened, including the booking ID if available and the step where the issue occurred?
reply.issue_resolved: Hi, thanks for your patience. This issue has been resolved. Please try again and let us know if you still face any problems.
